RAISES FULL-YEAR 2026 GUIDANCE RANGES AND PROVIDES PRELIMINARY THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS UDR, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: UDR), a leading multifamily real estate investment trust, announced today that it has raised its full-year 2026 guidance ranges for Net Income and Funds From Operations as Adjusted (“FFOA”) per diluted share, and provided preliminary results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This update is provided in conjunction with the Company’s separate announcement of the expected formation of a $2.0 billion strategic partnership with Apollo. Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Results and Outlook (1) The Company expects Net Income per diluted share for the third quarter 2026 will be $0.67, which compares to the previously provided guidance range of $0.13 to $0.15 per diluted share. Furthermore, the Company expects FFOA per diluted share for the third quarter 2026 will be $0.65, which represents the high-end of the previously provided guidance range of $0.63 to $0.65 per diluted share. As shown in the table below, the Company has established guidance ranges for the fourth quarter 2026 and has raised its previously provided full-year 2026 guidance ranges for Net Income and FFOA per diluted share. ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ Metric, per diluted share 3Q 2026 Preliminary YTD 2026 through 3Q 2026 Preliminary 4Q 2026 Outlook Prior Full-Year 2026 Outlook Updated Full-Year 2026 Outlook Full-Year 2026 Midpoint (Change) Net Income $0.67 $1.45 $0.13 to $0.15 $1.03 to $1.11 $1.58 to $1.60 $1.59 (+$0.52) FFO $0.62 $1.85 $0.63 to $0.65 $2.47 to $2.55 $2.48 to $2.50 $2.49 (-$0.02) FFOA $0.65 $1.90 $0.63 to $0.65 $2.49 to $2.57 $2.54 to $2.56 $2.55 (+$0.02) Year-Over-Year Same-Store (“SS”) Growth: ​ ​ ​ Revenue 1.8% 1.6% N/A 0.75% to 2.00% 1.4% to 1.8% 1.6% (+22.5bps) Expense 2.2% 3.2% N/A 2.75% to 3.75% 2.7% to 3.1% 2.9% (-35bps) NOI 1.6% 0.8% N/A 0.00% to 1.25% 0.8% to 1.2% 1.0% (+37.5bps) (1) All guidance is based on current expectations of future economic conditions and the judgment of the Company’s management team. A reconciliation of GAAP Net Income per diluted share to forecasted FFO and FFOA per diluted share for the fourth quarter and full-year 2026 can be found under “Reconciliation of Forecasted Net Income to FFO and FFO as Adjusted” in this release. Non-GAAP financial measures and other terms, as used in this release, are defined and further explained under “Definitions” in this release. Net Income, FFO and FFOA per share for all 2026 periods and guidance are unaffected by the Apollo transaction. SS growth metrics have been adjusted to exclude the 19 communities that comprise the joint venture with Apollo. Including these communities, SS Revenue, Expense, and NOI would be 1.5%, 2.7%, and 1.0% for 3Q 2026, 1.4%, 3.2%, and 0.5% for YTD 2026 through 3Q 2026, and 1.45%, 2.9%, and 0.75% for Full-Year 2026 Midpoint. Operating Update ​ ​ SS Metric (1) 3Q 2026, preliminary YTD 2026 through 3Q 2026 preliminary Weighted Average Physical Occupancy 96.5% 96.6% Effective Blended Lease Rate Growth 2.0% 2.2% (1) SS metrics have been adjusted to exclude the 19 communities that comprise the joint venture with Apollo. Including these communities, Weighted Average Physical Occupancy and Effective Blended Lease Rate Growth would be 96.6% and 1.7% for 3Q 2026 and 96.6% and 1.8% for YTD 2026 through 3Q 2026. 1 ​ Capital Allocation Activity During the quarter the Company, ● Sold two apartment communities, one each in Seattle and Nashville, with a combined 412 apartment homes for gross proceeds of $183.0 million. The Company remains under contract to sell a 296-home apartment community in the Metropolitan Washington, D.C. area for gross proceeds totaling approximately $68.5 million. ● As part of the previously announced runoff of its Debt and Preferred Equity portfolio, acquired a 483-home apartment community in Inland Empire, CA, and, as previously reported, a 286-home in Portland, OR, both upon the liquidation of the Company’s interests in previous Debt and Preferred Equity joint ventures, for an incremental cash outlay of $235.0 million based on a combined property valuation of $354.4 million. ● Expanded its joint venture with LaSalle Investment Management to approximately $958.3 million by contributing a 360-home apartment community in Nashville, TN, to the venture. Under the terms of the transaction, the Company received approximately $103.2 million in cash proceeds. ● Received a full repayment of approximately $29.5 million on its Preferred Equity investment in a stabilized apartment community in Orlando. Record Date Payment Date Amount October 19, 2026 November 2, 2026 $0.145 per common share November 16, 2026 November 30, 2026 $0.145 per common share December 15, 2026 December 31, 2026 $0.145 per common share ​ 3 Definitions Effective Blended Lease Rate Growth: The Company defines Effective Blended Lease Rate Growth as the combined proportional growth as a result of Effective New Lease Rate Growth and Effective Renewal Lease Rate Growth. Management considers Effective Blended Lease Rate Growth a useful metric for investors as it assesses combined proportional market-level, new and in-place demand trends. Effective New Lease Rate Growth: The Company defines Effective New Lease Rate Growth as the increase/(decrease) in gross potential rent realized less concessions on a straight-line basis for the new lease term (current effective rent) versus prior resident effective rent for the prior lease term on new leases commenced during the current quarter. Management considers Effective New Lease Rate Growth a useful metric for investors as it assesses market-level new demand trends. Effective Renewal Lease Rate Growth: The Company defines Effective Renewal Lease Rate Growth as the increase/(decrease) in gross potential rent realized less concessions on a straight-line basis for the new lease term (current effective rent) versus prior effective rent for the prior lease term on renewed leases commenced during the current quarter. Management considers Effective Renewal Lease Rate Growth a useful metric for investors as it assesses market-level, in-place demand trends. Funds From Operations as Adjusted (“FFO as Adjusted”) attributable to common stockholders and unitholders: The Company defines FFO as Adjusted attributable to common stockholders and unitholders as FFO excluding the impact of other non-comparable items including, but not limited to, acquisition-related costs, prepayment costs/benefits associated with early debt retirement, impairment write-downs or gains and losses on sales of real estate or other assets incidental to the main business of the Company and income taxes directly associated with those gains and losses, casualty-related expenses and recoveries, severance costs, software transition related costs and legal and other costs. Management believes that FFO as Adjusted is useful supplemental information regarding our operating performance as it provides a consistent comparison of our operating performance across time periods and allows investors to more easily compare our operating results with other REITs. reference.summary: UDR, Inc. is a S&P 500 company, is a leading multifamily real estate investment trust with a demonstrated performance history of delivering superior and dependable returns by successfully managing, buying, selling, developing and redeveloping attractive real estate properties in targeted U.S. markets. As of June 30, 2026, UDR owned or had an ownership position in 60,259 apartment homes, including 685 apartment homes under development. For over 54 years, UDR has delivered long-term value to shareholders, the best standard of service to residents and the highest quality experience for associates. UDR, Inc. was incorporated in 1972 in Maryland, and is based in Highlands Ranch, Colorado.
